note: G10 M8, the reviewer's own program. Okuma compares sequence numbers as names, so N0020 and N20 are two blocks. Renumbering writes N20 where N0020 stood, and the jumps IF [...] N0020 and GOTO N0010 have to take the new text although the number did not change: left alone they name blocks that no longer exist. The names NLAP1, NEND and NAT01 are labels and stay, the header and O1001 are no blocks, and a block skipped with / gets its number behind the mark.
